missingOrWeakCoverage: The 4,050 topic bank has nine learning areas and does not include IRE.
The 4,050 topic bank has 30 items per file but sample files inspected contain template questions and should not be counted as valid revision questions.
The Term 2 and Term 3 2027 draft batches contain only 5 MCQs and 2 structured questions per area, and are identical across the two terms.
The 2,002-question Term 1 bank has structured question templates and severe MCQ answer-position bias, requiring editorial and answer-key review.
buildDecision: Reuse existing files as source maps and curriculum-topic indexes, not as validated question counts. Extract actual questions from user-provided assessment PDFs and existing question papers/scoring guides, then supplement with original JSLH questions mapped to the Grade 7 KICD curriculum. Maintain source attribution/provenance internally, verify every answer, balance MCQ answer positions, create marking guides, and run validation before release.
releaseGate: No production publication until every required learning-area/term bank meets 80 MCQs and 120 structured questions, all items are subject-specific, answer keys/marking guides are verified, and duplicate/template checks pass.
